title: Players he remembers, and Steve Dunn
summary: Roy lists musicians he worked with, including Alvin Burroughs, Guy Jackson and trumpeter Steve Dunn of the Speed Webb band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: There were so many guys down through the years. Jesus! It would be impossible for me to think of the guys that I played with. Let's see. Alvin Burroughs. Chuck. [INAUDIBLE NAME] Charlie Lee, he's another tenor player that was good. Hen-Pie. Guy Jackson. Did you ever hear of him?
He was good, man. He's in a nursing home.
Alto. Yeah, he could play, man. Jesus. There were a lot of good trumpeters around then, cats that could play. Cincinnati had some good trumpet players around there. Savage.
I don't know... I think that's a dancer.
The guy that played like Joe Smith... I can't think of his name. He was with Speed Webb's band, too, for

a while. I'm trying to think of his name. I can see him now. Kind of an elegant-looking cat, you know. He had nice hair. Steve. Steve something. And there was a trombone player. Have you heard of (?)Young Smitty(?)?
Yeah, I've heard of 'im. Nobody seems to know his full name. He's just remembered as...
I think he was in Detroit. That's what I heard, the last I heard from him.
Was that trumpet player named Steve Dunn?
Yeah. How did you happen to pick up on that?
Well, I've seen a picture of the band, and I remembered the names of the... I remember him because naturally I knew you and Jonesey, but I'd never heard anything about him...
